scope: Local portable organization model; no new acceptance routes, gameplay tests or publication

checks.name: Release app and three Worker dry builds
Full Workspace plus final added model case
Pinned Worker runtime and synthetic D1 handoff/retry/export/task acceptance

acceptance_evidence: Typed native commands retain exact metadata snapshots and UTC acceptance times without task identities or game outbox entries.
Independent C# and TypeScript hashes bind every kind/action and exact Unicode patch. Absent/null/empty history defaults and all valid/invalid neutral cases agree with the pinned Workers runtime.

Unique causal revisions, kind/field/reference validation, exact prior/current snapshots, checksums and cross-role command/event identity fences reject portable corruption. Reversed wall-clock timestamps remain valid.
Name-only changes retain legacy non-Todo goal references and sets exceeding 100 IDs; new explicit goal replacements remain bounded at 100 IDs.

Existing task writes and Todo restoration retain organization history while current goal progress reflects current task state. Browser backup/restore and synthetic frozen cloud handoff/retry/export retain complete native history.
Optional history remains inside the canonical document, preserving existing atomic storage without a D1 schema migration or new secret.
limitations: Organization command acceptance, browser/MCP adapters, new write consent scope, production controls and real-client qualification remain separate.
No live gameplay test round or further deployment was run.
